ideas.pitch: An AI-powered emergency triage and remote vital sign monitor for pets that uses computer vision via smartphone camera to detect pain levels, respiratory distress, and provides immediate first-aid guidance.
ideas.title: PawGuard Emergency Triage & Vitals AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the PetTech & Animal Welfare track and the Smart Pet Healthcare & Emergency Assistance challenge, a niche where judges will appreciate direct collaboration partner PetsParivar's core focus.

ideas.pitch: A smart animal shelter matching system that analyzes adopter lifestyle parameters and pet behavioral assessments via a multi-agent framework to minimize return rates for rescued animals.
ideas.title: AdoptMatch Behavior-To-Home Biometric Matching
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted specifically at the Responsible Pet Adoption & Animal Welfare challenge, combining practical social impact with a sophisticated multi-agent matching algorithm.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and IoT simulation dashboard for smart campuses that optimizes waste collection routes based on real-time bin fullness and recyclable material classification.
ideas.title: CampusBin Intelligent Waste & Carbon Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Smart Campus & Smart City track and Smart Waste Management & Sustainability challenge, giving municipal and campus judges a concrete operational dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An accessibility platform providing real-time multimodal transcription, sign language avatar interpretation, and automated simplified lecture notes for students with diverse learning needs.
ideas.title: InclusiveClassroom AI Real-Time Accessible Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the AI for Accessibility & Inclusive Education challenge within the AI & Smart Technology track, hitting high social impact priorities for university judges.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized student safety alert system using offline-first Bluetooth mesh networking for dead-zone emergency communication combined with predictive heatmaps of campus lighting and historical incidents.
ideas.title: CampusSafe Panic-Mesh & Incident Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the Student Safety & Emergency Response challenge while showcasing systems-level thinking and graph/forecasting techniques similar to top-winning forecasting models.
